description: Lookup for the gap between what our static tools read and what a browser renders. Pass `finding`: a finding or tool name (for example "unnamed link", "alt text", "contrast", "touch targets", "duplicate landmark", "aria-hidden", "carousel") or a WCAG number. Returns when the static result over-reports, when it under-reports, how far to trust it, and a ready-to-run Puppeteer or DevTools snippet for the rendered check. With no `finding`, lists every id. Deterministic table; nothing is fetched or run.

finding.description: Finding type, tool name, WCAG number or plain description. Omit to list all.
